title: Graph triangle part of the product interchange grid
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, d1,d2 proper/open interchange diagrams for f:X→Y and g:Y→Z [def-pur-etale-graph-interchange-data], and n a selected side. Use the explicitly constructed neighborhood presentations barF,barG,barH, the mixed open N and the boundary barI of [lem-pur-etale-graph-product-ambient-pasting]. Let v_f:F.U→barF.U, v_g:G.U→barG.U and v_h:H.U→barH.U be the canonical open inclusions from the intersections of the two supports. Define s_f,s_g,s_h as the inverses of the normalized identity-top proper graph-triangle exchanges for a_product v=z, followed by the open compositors for v j=e_product. Then barI;s_h=(s_f whiskered by barG);(s_g whiskered by F);productInterchange [def-pur-etale-graph-product-interchange]. This equality has no original supplied diagram interchange and no proper-ambient lambda factor.

lean.statement: theorem etaleGraphProductShrinkPasting (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z} (d₁ d₂ : EtaleGraphInterchangeDiagram f g) (second : Bool) : (match second with | false => let sf := EtaleGraphPresentation.ProductRow.shrinkLambda d₁.sourcePresentation d₂.sourcePresentation false A let sg := EtaleGraphPresentation.ProductRow.shrinkLambda (EtaleGraphPresentation.ofCompactification d₁.compactification) (EtaleGraphPresentation.ofCompactification d₂.compactification) false A let sh := EtaleGraphPresentation.ProductRow.shrinkLambda d₁.compositePresentation d₂.compositePresentation false A (EtaleGraphInterchangeDiagram.ProductRow.First.interchange d₁ d₂ A).hom ≫ sh.hom = Functor.whiskerRight sf.hom ((EtaleGraphInterchangeDiagram.ProductRow.First.G d₁ d₂).functor A) ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft ((d₁.productF d₂).functor A) sg.hom ≫ (d₁.productInterchange d₂ A).hom | true => let sf := EtaleGraphPresentation.ProductRow.shrinkLambda d₁.sourcePresentation d₂.sourcePresentation true A let sg := EtaleGraphPresentation.ProductRow.shrinkLambda (EtaleGraphPresentation.ofCompactification d₁.compactification) (EtaleGraphPresentation.ofCompactification d₂.compactification) true A let sh := EtaleGraphPresentation.ProductRow.shrinkLambda d₁.compositePresentation d₂.compositePresentation true A (EtaleGraphInterchangeDiagram.ProductRow.Second.interchange d₁ d₂ A).hom ≫ sh.hom = Functor.whiskerRight sf.hom ((EtaleGraphInterchangeDiagram.ProductRow.Second.G d₁ d₂).functor A) ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft ((d₁.productF d₂).functor A) sg.hom ≫ (d₁.productInterchange d₂ A).hom )
